actor Main
  new create(env: Env) => env.input(recover InputNotifyExample(env) end, 1024)

class InputNotifyExample is InputNotify
  let _env: Env
  var _acc: String = ""
  new create(env: Env) => _env = env
  fun ref apply(data: Array[U8] iso) => _acc = _acc + String.from_iso_array(consume data)
  fun ref dispose() =>
    var n: U64 = 0
    for c in _acc.values() do
      if (c >= '0') and (c <= '9') then n = (n * 10) + (c - '0').u64() end
    end
    _env.out.print((n * 2).string())
